text: As the period of a periodic function tends to infinity, the Fourier series passes to the Fourier transform because:
choices: the discrete frequencies merge into a continuous spectrum and the sum becomes an integral
the coefficients all tend to zero and the function becomes constant
the function is forced to become even
orthogonality is lost in the limit
explanation: Letting L grow spaces the harmonics n*pi/L infinitesimally, so the discrete sum over n becomes an integral over a continuous frequency (the Fourier integral theorem). Orthogonality persists as a delta-function relation rather than being lost.
